_comment: Editable domain taxonomy for the knowledge brain. Drives BOTH card routing (knowledge_domain.py) and the per-domain rarity baseline (knowledge_fold.py). Add a domain by appending an entry here -- no code change. 'expert_baseline' is the persona rarity is scored against ('would THEY already know this'); phrase it as a noun phrase. Keep 'general' last as the fallback.

domains.desc: Cold email / cold DM / outbound to strangers: deliverability, sending infrastructure, list-building for cold outreach, cold scripts, reply rates, booking meetings cold.
domains.expert_baseline: a seasoned B2B cold-outreach operator who runs high-volume cold email and DM at scale

domains.desc: Running PAID ads (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google): account structure, media buying, targeting, budgets, scaling, testing methodology, attribution.
domains.expert_baseline: a seasoned 7-figure DTC performance marketer who buys and scales paid media daily

domains.desc: The ad CREATIVE itself: hooks, first three seconds, UGC formats, ad scripts, angles, visual concepts, what makes a scroll-stopping ad, creative testing.
domains.expert_baseline: a seasoned direct-response creative strategist who has shipped thousands of performance ads

domains.desc: Landing pages, sales pages, offers, funnels, conversion-rate optimization, checkout, pricing of the offer.
domains.expert_baseline: a seasoned CRO and offer strategist who has built and tested many sales funnels

domains.desc: Ecommerce / Shopify store operations, merchandising, product pages, retention, fulfillment, DTC business ops.
domains.expert_baseline: an experienced DTC ecommerce operator who runs a Shopify store day to day

domains.desc: OWNED email and SMS lifecycle marketing (NOT cold): welcome / abandonment / post-purchase flows, newsletters, list retention and monetization.
domains.expert_baseline: an experienced lifecycle and retention marketer who owns email and SMS flows

domains.desc: Organic / short-form content: TikTok, Reels, YouTube, personal brand, content that builds an audience without paying for reach.
domains.expert_baseline: an experienced content creator and organic-growth operator with a large audience

domains.desc: TikTok Shop selling and social commerce: affiliate / creator seeding, live shopping, TikTok Shop listings, GMV max, sample-to-creator ops. Distinct from generic ecommerce store ops.
domains.expert_baseline: an experienced TikTok Shop and social-commerce operator running affiliate seeding and live selling

domains.desc: Positioning, brand, offer strategy, business strategy, mindset, decision-making. Cross-cutting.
domains.expert_baseline: a seasoned brand and business strategist and operator

domains.desc: AI / automation tools, agents, and workflows used to run or scale the business. Cross-cutting.
domains.expert_baseline: a technical operator fluent in AI tools, agents, and automation for business

domains.desc: Genuinely broad business insight with no single clear domain.
